title: Tim Phillips confirms Borland's two drawings were classified under a security classification guide

tellings.quote: >> and Tim Phillips acknowledged yes Dylan drew two drawings and yes Arrow was told what to classify because of his security classification guide.

plain: Dylan Borland, a guest who says a government official told him aliens run everything, says that Tim Phillips, an official he links to AARO (the Pentagon office set up to look into UFO reports), confirmed that "Dylan drew two drawings" and that AARO was told to classify them under Borland's security classification guide, the document that sets out what information must be kept secret. Borland tells Michels this second-hand and also names Sean Kirkpatrick in the story. If true, the government treated what Borland drew as real secrets.
